description: Change the account's own notification settings for one room; only the fields you send change. muted: true silences the room on the human's devices, so do it only when they asked.

custom_sound.description: Canonical sound id for this room's Pings, e.g. "ting". An empty string goes back to the room's sound.

muted.description: true mutes this member's Pings in the room; false unmutes them.

user_id.description: A person's user_id, as list_room_members and list_invitable_people return it.

muted.description: Mute or unmute the whole room.

silent_mode.description: Deliver this room's Pings without sound.

name: update_room_preferences

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Update Room Preferences
